A preventive control is also configured to require that data put into Amazon S3 is encrypted using a KMS key. These two mechanisms ensure that data stored in Amazon S3 is encrypted using a key that is managed and controlled by the customer.\\\\n\\\\nSimilar to Amazon S3, Amazon ECR is also used to store customer-built Docker containers that are likely to contain intellectual property. Amazon ECR supports the encryption of images at rest using a CMK. This enables you to support PCI-DSS compliance requirements for separate authentication of the storage and cryptography. The following set of AWS services provide data\\\\nencryption support with a KMS key.\\\\n\\\\n* SageMaker AI Processing, SageMaker AI Training (including AutoPilot), SageMaker AI Hosting (including\\\\n Model Monitoring), SageMaker AI Batch Transform, SageMaker AI Notebook instance, SageMaker AI Feature Store,\\\\n Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon ECR, AWS CodeBuild, AWS Step Functions, AWS Lambda, Amazon EFS.\\\\n\\\\nAWS KMS provides\\\\norganizations with a fully managed service to centrally control their encryption keys. If\\\\ncompliance needs dictate that keys must be frequently rotated, you can manually rotate the CMK\\\\nwith a new CMK.
